// diagnostic E3004

Jet.TaskCanceled

*Retired* (was: a task was canceled at a cooperative wait point)

What

*Retired* (was: a task was canceled at a cooperative wait point)

Why

Cancellation is a value, not a stop: a canceled task's join gives `TaskFailure.Canceled`, a canceled root drains its scope and exits, and an unhandled `Canceled` reports through the ordinary failure report; the code is registered again if cancellation ever becomes a coded stop

Fix

Do not use E3004
